Su.head: Description of the Sun
Su.text: The Sun's eyes are honey-coloured. He has a square body. He is of clean habits, bilious, intelligent and has limited hair (on his head).

During the dasa of the Sun there is acquisition of wealth, great felicity and honours from the Government, if at the time of birth the Sun is in his own rashi, in his exaltation rashi, in a kendra, in the 11th, be associated with the Lord of Dharma, or the Lord of Karma and strong in his Varg. The native will be blessed with a son (children), if the Sun is with the Lord of Putra. The native will acquire elephants and other kinds of wealth, if the Sun is associated with the Lord of Dhana. The native will enjoy comforts of conveyances, if the Sun is associated with the Lord of Bandhu. He attains a high position, like that of Army Chief, by the beneficence of the king and enjoys all kinds of happiness. Thus during the dasa of a strong (and favourable) the Sun there are acquisitions of clothes, agricultural products, wealth, honours, conveyances etc.

During the dasa of the Sun there will be anxieties, loss of wealth, punishment from Government, defamation, opposition by kinsmen, distress to father, (in)auspicious happenings at home, distress to paternal and maternal uncles etc., anxiety and inimical relations with other people for no reason whatsoever, should the Sun be in his rashi of debilitation, be weak in the 6th, Randhra, or Vyaya, or be associated with malefic grahas, or with the Lord of Ari, Randhra, or Vyaya. There will be some favourable effects at times, if in the above situations the Sun receives a drishti from benefic grahas. The effects will always be unfavourable, when malefic grahas give a drishti to the Sun.

Mo.head: Description of the Moon
Mo.text: The Moon is very windy and phlegmatic. She is learned and has a round body. She has auspicious looks and sweet speech, is fickle-minded and very lustful.

O Brahmin! After describing the effects of the dasa of the Sun in brief, I will now come to the effects of Vimshottari dasa of the Moon. During the dasa of the Moon from its commencement to the end there will be opulence and glory, good fortune, gain of wealth, auspicious functions at home, dawn of fortune, attainment of a high position in Government, acquisition of conveyances, clothes, birth of children and acquisition of cattle, should the Moon be in her exaltation, in her own rashi, in kendra, in the 11th, Dharma, or Putra, be associated with, or receives a drishti from benefics, be fully powerful and is associated with the Lord of Karma, Dharma, or Bandhu. There will be extraordinary gains of wealth and luxuries, if such a the Moon is in the 2nd bhava.

Should the Moon be waning, or in her debilitation rashi, there will be loss of wealth in her dasa. If the Moon is in the 3rd, there will be happiness off and on. If the Moon is associated with malefics, there will be idiocy, mental tension, trouble from employees and mother and loss of wealth. If waning the Moon is in the 6th, Randhra, or Vyaya, or is associated with malefics, there will be inimical relations with Government, loss of wealth, distress to mother and similar evil effects. If a strong the Moon is placed in the 6th, Randhra, or Vyaya there will be troubles and good times off and on.

Ma.head: Description of Mars
Ma.text: Mars has blood-red eyes, is fickle-minded, liberal, bilious, given to anger and has thin waist and thin physique.

If Mars is in his exaltation, in his moolatrikona, in his own rashi, in kendra, in the 11th, or the 2nd bhava with strength, in a benefic amsa (navamsa) and is associated with a benefic, there will be during his dasa acquisition of kingdom (attainment of a high administrative, or political position in Government, gain of wealth and land, recognition by Government), gain of wealth from foreign countries and acquisition of conveyances and ornaments. There will also be happiness and good relations with co-borns. If Mars with strength is placed in a kendra, or in the 3rd, there will be gain of wealth through valour, victory over enemies, happiness from wife and children. There will, however, be a possibility of some unfavourable effects at the end of the dasa.

If Mars is in his debilitation rashi, weak, in an inauspicious bhava, or is associated with, or receives a drishti from malefics, there will be in his dasa loss of wealth, distress and similar unfavourable effects.

Me.head: Description of Mercury
Me.text: Mercury is endowed with an attractive physique and the capacity to use words with many meanings. He is fond of jokes. He has a mix of all the three humours.
Now I am going to describe the effects of the dasa of Mercury, who is called a Kumar (in his teens) amongst all the grahas.

If Mercury is in his exaltation, in his own, in a friendly rashi, or in the 11th, Putra, or Dharma, there will be during his dasa acquisition of wealth, gain of reputation, improvement in knowledge, benevolence of Government, auspicious functions, happiness from wife and children, good health, availability of sweetish preparations, profits in business etc. If Mercury receives a drishti from a benefic, is in the 9th, or is the Lord of Karma, the aforesaid beneficial results will be experienced in full and there will be great felicity all-round.

If Mercury is associated with a malefic, there will be during his dasa punishment by Government, inimical relations with kinsmen, journey to a foreign country, dependence on others and the possibility of urinary troubles. If Mercury is in the 6th, Randhra, or Vyaya, there will be loss of wealth, due to indulgence in lascivious activities, possibility of suffering from rheumatism and jaundice, danger of thefts and malevolence of Government, loss of land and cattle etc. At the commencement of the dasa of Mercury, there will be gains of wealth, betterment in the educational sphere, birth of children and happiness. In the middle of the dasa, there will be recognition from Government. The last part of the dasa will be distressful.

Ju.head: Description of Jupiter
Ju.text: Jupiter has a big body, tawny hair and tawny eyes, is phlegmatic, intelligent and learned in Shastras.
Now I am going to describe the effects of the dasa of Jupiter, the great benefic and preceptor of the Gods.

If Jupiter is in his exaltation, his own rashi, his moolatrikona, in the 10th, Putra, or the 9th bhava, in his own navamsa, or in his exalted navamsa, there will be during his dasa: acquisition of kingdom, great felicity, recognition by Government, acquisition of conveyances and clothes, devotion to deities and Brahmins, happiness in respect of his wife and children and success in the performance of religious sacrifices (oblations).

If Jupiter is in his debilitation rashi, combust, associated with malefics, or in the 6th, or Randhra, there will be during his dasa loss of residential premises, anxiety, distress to children, loss of cattle and pilgrimage. The dasa will give some unfavourable effects at its commencement only. During the later part of the dasa there will be good effects, like gain of wealth, awards from and recognition by Government.

Ve.head: Description of Venus
Ve.text: Venus is charming, has a splendourous physique, is excellent, or great in disposition, has charming eyes, is a poet, is phlegmatic and windy and has curly hair.
Now I will describe the effects of the dasa of Venus, who is the incarnate of intoxication, ecstasy, delight and pride amongst all the grahas.

If Venus is in his exaltation, in his own rashi, or in a kendra, or a trikona, there will be during his dasa acquisition of fancy clothes, ornaments, conveyances, cattle and land etc., availability of sweet preparations every day, recognition from the sovereign, luxurious functions of songs and dances etc. by the benevolence of Goddess Lakshmi. If Venus is in his moolatrikona, during his dasa there will definitely be acquisition of a kingdom, acquisition of a house, birth of children and grandchildren, celebration of marriage in the family, attainment of a high position, like the Commander of an Army, visits of friends, recovery of lost wealth, property, or kingdom.
If Venus is in the 6th, Randhra, or Vyaya, there will be during his dasa inimical relations with kinsmen, distress to wife, losses in business, destruction of cattle and separation from relations.

If Venus is in the 4th, as Lord of Dharma, or Karma, there will be during his dasa attainment of rulership of a country, or village, performance of pious deeds, like building of reservoirs and temples and giving grains etc. in charity, availability of sweet preparations every day, vigor in work, name and fame and happiness from wife and children.

Similar are the effects of Venus in his sub-periods. If Venus is Lord of Dhana, or Yuvati, there will be during his dasa physical pains and troubles. To get alleviation from those troubles the native should perform Shatarudriya, or Mrityunjaya Japa in the prescribed manner and give in charity a cow, or female buffalo.

Sa.head: Description of Saturn
Sa.text: Saturn has an emaciated and long physique, has tawny eyes, is windy in temperament, has big teeth, is indolent and lame and has coarse hair.
Now I will describe to you the effects of the dasa of Saturn, who is considered the vilest and most inferior amongst all the grahas.

If Saturn is in his exaltation, in his own rashi, or in moolatrikona, or friendly rashi, in his own, or exalted navamsa and in the 3rd, or Labha, there will be during his dasa recognition by Government, opulence and glory, name and fame, success in the educational sphere, acquisition of conveyances and ornaments etc., gain of wealth, favours from Government, attainment of a high position, like Commander of an Army, acquisition of a kingdom, benevolence of goddess Lakshmi, gain of property and birth of children.

If Saturn is in the 6th, Randhra, or Vyaya, in his debilitation rashi, or combust, there will be during his dasa ill effects from poison, injury from weapons, separation from father, distress to wife and children, disaster, as a result of displeasure of Government, imprisonment etc. If Saturn receives a drishti from, or is associated with a benefic, is placed in a kendra, or in a trikona, in Sagittarius, or in Pisces, there will be acquisition of a kingdom, conveyances and clothes.

Ra.head: Description of Rahu and Ketu
Ra.text: Rahu has smoky appearance with a blue mix physique. He resides in forests and is horrible. He is windy in temperament and is intelligent. Ketu is akin to Rahu.

In order to clarify the effects of the dasa of Rahu I shall first mention the exaltation and debilitation rashis of Rahu and Ketu. The exaltation rashi of Rahu is Taurus. The exaltation rashi of Ketu is Scorpio. The moolatrikonas of Rahu and Ketu are Gemini and Sagittarius. The own rashis of Rahu and Ketu are Aquarius and Scorpio. Some sages have expressed the view, that Virgo is the own rashi of Rahu and Pisces is the own rashi of Ketu. Should Rahu be in his exaltation rashi etc., there will be during the dasa of Rahu great happiness from acquisition of wealth, agricultural products etc., acquisition of conveyances with the help of friends and Government, construction of a new house, birth of sons (children), religious inclinations, recognition from Government of foreign countries and gain of wealth, clothes etc. If Rahu be associated with, or receives a drishti from benefics, be in a benefic rashi and be in the 1st, Bandhu, Yuvati, Karma, Labha, or Sahaja, there will be during his dasa all kinds of comforts by the beneficence of the Government, acquisition of wealth through a foreign Government, or sovereign and felicity at home.

If Rahu is in the 8th, or the 12th bhava, there will be during his dasa all kinds of troubles and distress. If Rahu is associated with a malefic, or a maraka graha, or is in his debilitation rashi, there will be loss of position, destruction of his residential house, mental agony, trouble to wife and children and misfortune of getting bad food. There will be loss of wealth at the commencement of the dasa, some relief and gain of wealth in his own country and distress and anxieties during the last portion of the dasa.

Ke.head: Description of Rahu and Ketu
Ke.text: Rahu has smoky appearance with a blue mix physique. He resides in forests and is horrible. He is windy in temperament and is intelligent. Ketu is akin to Rahu.
Now I will tell you about the dasa of Ketu, who is a headless trunk (Kabandha) amongst all the grahas.

If Ketu is in a kendra, a trikona, or in the 11th, in a benefic rashi, in his exaltation, or in his own rashi, there will be during his dasa cordial relations with the king, desired headship of a country, or village, comforts of conveyances, happiness from children, gain from foreign countries, happiness from wife and acquisition of cattle. If Ketu is in the 3rd, Ari, or Labha, there will be in his dasa acquisition of a kingdom, good relations with friends and opportunities for the acquisition of elephants. At the commencement of the Ketu dasa there will be Raj Yog. During the middle portion of the dasa there will be possibilities of fearfulness and in the last part there will be sufferings from ailments and journeys to distant places. If Ketu is in the 2nd, Randhra, or Vyaya, or receives a drishti from a malefic, there will be imprisonment, destruction of kinsmen and residential premises and anxieties, company of menials and diseases.

grahas_all.head: Graha governances
grahas_all.text: The Sun is the soul of all. The Moon is the mind. Mars is one's strength. Mercury is speech-giver, while Jupiter confers Knowledge and happiness. Venus governs semen (potency), while Saturn denotes grief.

grahas_all.head: Graha cabinet
grahas_all.text: Of royal status are the Sun and the Moon, while Mars is the Army chief. Prince-apparent is Mercury. The ministerial grahas are Jupiter and Venus. Saturn is a servant. Rahu and Ketu form the graha Army.

grahas_all.head: Complexions of grahas
grahas_all.text: The Sun is blood-red. The Moon is tawny. Mars, who is not very tall is blood-red, while Mercury's hue is akin to that of green grass. Tawny, variegated and dark are Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in their order.

grahas_all.head: Deities of grahas
grahas_all.text: Fire (Agni) (?), Water (Varuna), Subrahmanya (Lord Shiva's son, following Ganesh), Maha Vishnu, Indra, Shachi Devi (the consort of Lord Indra) and Brahma (?) are the presiding deities of the 7 grahas in their order.

grahas_all.head: Gender of the grahas
grahas_all.text: Mercury and Saturn are neuters. The Moon and Venus are females, while the Sun, Mars and Jupiter are males.

grahas_all.head: Primordial compounds
grahas_all.text: The Panchabhutas, space, air, fire, water and earth, are, respectively, governed by Jupiter, Saturn, Mars, Venus and Mercury.

grahas_all.head: Castes of grahas
grahas_all.text: Jupiter and Venus are Brahmins. The Sun is a royal graha, while the Moon and Mercury belong to commercial community. Saturn rules the Sudras (4th caste).
Sattvic grahas are the luminaries and Jupiter, Venus and Mercury are Rajasik, while Mars and Saturn are Tamasic.

grahas_all.head: Primary ingredients (or Sapth Dhatus)
grahas_all.text: Bones, blood, marrow, skin, fat, semen and muscles are, respectively, denoted by the grahas: the Sun, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn.

grahas_all.head: Abodes of the grahas
grahas_all.text: Temple, watery place, place of fire, sport-ground, treasure-house, bed-room and filthy ground: these are, respectively, the abodes for the seven grahas from the Sun onward.

grahas_all.head: Graha periods
grahas_all.text: Ayan, Muhurta, a day (consisting day and night), Ritu, month, fortnight and year: these are the periods allotted to the grahas from the Sun to Saturn.

grahas_all.head: Tastes of the grahas
grahas_all.text: Pungent, saline, bitter, mixed, sweet, acidulous and astringent are, respectively, tastes lorded by the Sun, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn.

grahas_all.head: Strengths of grahas
grahas_all.text: Strong in the East are Mercury and Jupiter. The Sun and Mars are so in the South, while Saturn is the only graha, that derives strength in the West. The Moon and Venus are endowed with vigour, when in the North. Again, strong during night are the Moon, Mars and Saturn, while Mercury is strong during day and night. The rest (i.e. Jupiter, the Sun and Venus) are strong only in daytime. During the dark half malefics are strong. Benefics acquire strength in the bright half of the month. Malefics and benefics are, respectively, strong in Dakshinayan and Uttarayan. The Lords of the year, month, day and Hora (hour of graha) are stronger than the other in ascending order. Again, stronger than the other in the ascending are Saturn, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, the Moon and the Sun.

grahas_all.head: Related to trees
grahas_all.text: The Sun rules strong trees (i.e. trees with stout trunks), Saturn useless trees, the Moon milky trees (and rubber yielding plants), Mars bitter ones (like lemon plants), Venus floral plants, Jupiter fruitful ones and Mercury fruitless ones.

grahas_all.head: Other matters
grahas_all.text: Rahu rules the outcaste, while Ketu governs mixed caste. Saturn and the nodes indicate ant-hills. Rahu denotes multi-coloured clothes and Ketu rags. Lead and blue gem belong to Rahu and Ketu. The Sun, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in their order govern red silken, white silken, red, black silken, saffron, silken and multi-coloured robes.

grahas_all.head: Seasons of grahas
grahas_all.text: Vasanta, Greeshma, Varsh, Sarad, Hemanta and Sisir are the six Ritus (or seasons), respectively, governed by Venus, Mars, the Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn. Rahu and Ketu denote 8 months and 3 months, respectively.

grahas_all.head: Dhatu, Mool and Jiva Divisions
grahas_all.text: Dhatu grahas are Rahu, Mars, Saturn and the Moon, while the Sun and Venus are Mula grahas. Mercury, Jupiter and Ketu rule Jivas.

grahas_all.head: Age
grahas_all.text: Out of all the grahas Saturn is the eldest. He bestows maximum number of years in Naisargik dasa.

grahas_all.head: Exaltation and Debilitation
grahas_all.text: For the seven grahas, from the Sun on, the exaltation rashis are, respectively, Aries, Taurus, Capricorn, Virgo, Cancer, Pisces and Libra. The deepest exaltation degrees are, respectively, 10, 3, 28, 15, 5, 27 and 20 in those rashis. And in the seventh rashi from the said exaltation rashi each graha has its own debilitation. The same degrees of deep exaltation apply to deep fall.

grahas_all.head: Additional Dignities
grahas_all.text: In Leo the first 20 degrees are the Sun's moolatrikona, while the rest is his own bhava. After the first 3 degrees of exaltation portion in Taurus, for the Moon, the rest is her moolatrikona. Mars has the first 12 degrees in Aries, as moolatrikona with the rest therein becoming simply his own bhava. For Mercury, in Virgo the first 15 degrees are exaltation zone, the next 5 degrees moolatrikona and the last 10 degrees are own bhava. The first one third of Sagittarius is the moolatrikona of Jupiter, while the remaining part thereof is his own bhava. Venus divides Libra into two halves keeping the first, as moolatrikona and the second, as own bhava. Saturn's arrangements are same in Aquarius, as the Sun has in Leo.

grahas_all.head: Natural Relationships
grahas_all.text: Note the rashis, which are the 2nd, 4th, 5th, 8th, 9th and 12th from the moolatrikona of a graha. The grahas ruling such rashis are its friends, apart from the Lord of its exaltation rashi. Lords other than these are its enemies. If a graha becomes its friend as well, as its enemy (on account of the said two computations), then it is neutral, or equal.

1.head: Aries described
1.text: Aries is blood-red in complexion. It has a prominent (big) physique. It is a quadruped rashi and strong during night. It denotes courage. It resides in the East and is related to kings. It wanders in hills and predominates in Rajo-guna (the second of the three constituent qualities and the cause of great activity in living beings). It rises with its back (a Prishtodaya rashi) and is fiery. Its ruler is Mars.

2.head: Taurus described
2.text: Taurus's complexion is white and it is lorded by Venus. It is long and is a quadruped rashi. It has strength in night and resides in the South. It represents villages and businessmen. An earthy rashi, Taurus rises with its back.

3.head: Gemini described
3.text: The rashi Gemini rises with its head and represents a male and a female, holding a mace and lute. It lives in the West and is an airy rashi. It is a biped rashi as well and is strong in nights. It lives in villages and is windy in temperament. It has an even body with a green (grass like) hue. Its ruler is Mercury.

4.head: Cancer described
4.text: The rashi Cancer is pale-red. It resorts to forests and represents Brahmins. It is strong in nights. It has many feet (i.e. it is a centipede rashi) and has a bulky body. It is Sattvic in disposition (seen in gods) and it is a watery rashi. It rises with its back and is ruled by the Moon.

5.head: Leo described
5.text: Leo is ruled by the Sun and is Sattvic. It is a quadruped rashi and a royal rashi. It resorts to forests and rises with its head. It has a large, white body. It resides in the East and is strong during daytime.

6.head: Virgo described
6.text: This rashi is a hill-resorter and is strong in daytime. It rises with its head and has a medium build. It is a biped rashi and resides in the South. It has grains and fire in its hands. It belongs to the business community and is variegated. It relates to hurricanes ('Prabharanjani'). It is a Virgin and is Tamasic (a disposition of demons). Its ruler is Mercury.

7.head: Libra described
7.text: Libra is a Seershodaya rashi, rising with its head; Libra is strong in daytime. It is black in complexion and is predominant with Rajo-guna. It relates to the western direction and resorts to land. It is destructive, or mischievous ('Dhatin'). It represents Sudras, or the 4th Varna. It has a medium build physique and is a biped rashi. Its Lord is Venus.

8.head: Scorpio described
8.text: Scorpio has a slender physique and is a centipede rashi. It denotes Brahmins and resides in holes. Its direction is North and it is strong in daytime. It is reddish-brown and resorts to water and land. It has a hairy physique and is very sharp (or passionate). Mars is its ruler.

9.head: Sagittarius described
9.text: The rashi Sagittarius rises with its head and is lorded by Jupiter. It is a Sattvic rashi and is tawny in hue. It has strength in night and is fiery. A royal rashi, Sagittarius is biped in first half. Its second half is quadruped. It has an even build and adores an arch. It resides in the East, resorts to land and is splendourous.

10.head: Capricorn described
10.text: Capricorn is lorded by Saturn and has predominance of Tamo-guna (a disposition, seen in demons). It is an earthy rashi and represents the southern direction. It is strong in nights and rises with back. It has a large body. Its complexion is variegated and it resorts to both forests and lands. Its first half is quadruped and its second half footless, moving in water.

11.head: Aquarius described
11.text: The rashi Aquarius represents a man holding a pot. Its complexion is deep-brown. It has medium build and is a biped rashi. It is very strong in daytime. It resorts to deep water and is airy. It rises with its head and is Tamasic. It rules Sudras, the 4th Varna and the West. Its Lord is Saturn, the Sun's offspring.

12.head: Pisces described
12.text: Pisces resembles a pair of fish, one tailed with the head of the other. This rashi is strong at night. It is a watery rashi and is predominant with Sattva-guna. It denotes resoluteness and is a water-resorter. It is footless and has a medium build. It rules the North and rises with both head and back. It is ruled by Jupiter.

rashis_all.head: Limbs of Kalapurusha
rashis_all.text: Kalapurusha (or Time personified) has his limbs, as under with reference to the 12 rashis, respectively: Head, face, arms, heart, stomach, hip, space below navel, privities, thighs, knees, ankles and feet.

rashis_all.head: Classification of rashis
rashis_all.text: Movable, Fixed and Dual are the names given to the 12 rashis in order. These are again known, as malefic and benefic, successively. Similarly are male and female. Aries, Leo and Sagittarius are bilious. Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn are windy. Gemini, Libra and Aquarius are mixed, while the rest are phlegmatic.

1.head: Indications of the 1st bhava
1.text: Physique, appearance, intellect (or the organ of intelligence, i.e. brain), complexion of the body, vigour, weakness, happiness, grief and innate nature are all to be guessed through the ascending rashi.

1.head: Physical comforts
1.text: Should the 1st lord be yuti with a malefic, or be in the 8th, 6th, or 12th, physical felicity will diminish. If he is in an angle, or trine there will be at all times comforts of the body. If the 1st lord is in debilitation, combustion, or enemy's rashi, there will be diseases. With a benefic in an angle, or trine all diseases will disappear. The Lagna's angles (i.e. Bandhu, Yuvati, or the 10th), or its trine (Putra, Dharma), containing a benefic, is a powerful remedy for all, related to health.
There will not be bodily health, if the Lagna, or the Moon be drishtied by, or yuti with a malefic, being devoid of a benefics drishti.

1.head: Bodily Beauty
1.text: A benefic in the 1st will give a pleasing appearance, while a malefic will make one bereft of good appearance. Felicity of the body will be enjoyed, if the Lagna is drishtied by, or yuti with a benefic.

1.head: Other Benefits
1.text: If the 1st lord, Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus be in an angle, or in a trine, the native will be long lived, wealthy, intelligent and liked by the king. Fame, wealth, abundant pleasures and comforts of the body will be acquired, if the 1st lord is in a Movable rashi and be drishtied by a benefic graha. One will be endowed with royal marks (of fortune), if Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus be in the 1st along with the Moon, or be in angle from the Lagna. If Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus be in 4th, 7th, or 10th from the Lagna, or be in the company of the Moon in the 1st, the native will enjoy royal fortunes.

1.head: Coiled Birth
1.text: If there be a birth in one of Aries, Taurus and Leo lagnas, containing either Saturn, or Mars, the birth of the child is with a coil around a limb. The corresponding limb will be in accordance with the rashi, or navamsa, rising.

1.head: Birth of Twins
1.text: The native, who has the Sun in a quadruped rashi, while others are in Dual rashis with strength, is born, as one of the twins.

1.head: To Be Nurtured by Three Mothers
1.text: If the Sun and the Moon join in one and the same bhava and fall in one navamsa, the native will be nurtured by three different mothers for the first three months from its birth and will later on be brought up by its father and brother. ('Bhratri' apart from meaning a brother calls for interpretation, as a near relative in general)

1.head: Important
1.text: The learned in Jyotish should base the effects on the Moon also, as are applicable to the Lagna. Now explained are clues to know of ulcers, identity marks etc. on one's person.

1.head: Decanates and Bodily Limbs
1.text: Head, eyes, ears, nose, temple, chin and face is the order of limbs, denoted (by the various bhavas), when the first decanate of a rashi ascends. In the case of the second decanate ascending the order is neck, shoulder, arm, side, heart, stomach and navel. The order for the third decanate ascending is pelvis, anus/penis, testicles, thigh, knee, calf and foot. The portion already risen indicates left side of the body (while the one yet to rise, i.e. The invisible half, denotes the right side of the body).

1.head: Limbs Affected
1.text: The limb, related to a malefic by occupation, will have ulcers, or scars, while the one, related to a benefic, will have a mark (like moles etc). So say the Jyotishis. (Also see Sloka 6, Ch. 4 of Saravali, which states, that a malefic, or a benefic, if be in own rashi, or navamsa, the effects will be right from birth. In other cases it will be in the course of one's life, that these effects will come to pass)

2.head: Indications of the 2nd bhava
2.text: Wealth, grains (food etc.), family, death, enemies, metals, precious stones etc. are to be understood through the 2nd bhava.

2.head: Combinations for Wealth
2.text: O excellent of the Brahmins, listen to me, speaking on the effects of the 2nd bhava. If the Lord of Dhana is in the 2nd, or is in an angle, or in trine, he will promote one's wealth (or monetary state). Should he be in the 6th/8th/12th, financial conditions will decline. A benefic in the 2nd will give wealth, while a malefic instead will destroy wealth.
One will be wealthy, if Jupiter is in the 2nd, as the Lord of Dhana, or is with Mars.
If the 2nd lord is in the 11th, while the Lord of Labha in the 2nd, wealth will be acquired by the native. Alternately these two Lords may join in an angle, or in a trine.
If the Lord of Dhana is in an angle, while the 11th lord is in a trine thereof, or is drishtied by, or yuti with Jupiter and Venus, the subject will be wealthy.

2.head: Yogas for Poverty
2.text: One will be penniless, if the Lord of the 2nd bhava is in an evil bhava, while the Lord of the 11th bhava is also so placed and the 2nd bhava is occupied by a malefic. There will be penury right from birth and the native will have to beg even for his food, if the Lords of Dhana and the 11th bhava are both combust, or with malefics.

2.head: Loss of Wealth through the King
2.text: Should the Lords of Dhana and the 11th bhava be relegated to Ari, Randhra, or the 12th bhava, while Mars is in the 11th bhava and Rahu is in the 2nd bhava, the native will lose his wealth on account of royal punishments.

2.head: Expenses on Good Accounts
2.text: When Jupiter is in the 11th, Venus is in the 2nd and a benefic is placed in the 12th bhava, while the 2nd lord is yuti with a benefic, there will be expenses on religious, or charitable grounds.

2.head: Fame etc
2.text: If the 2nd lord is in own rashi, or is exalted, the native will look after his people, will help others and also will become famous.

2.head: Effortless Aquisition
2.text: If the 2nd lord is yuti with a benefic and is in a good division, like Paravatāńś, there will be effortlessly all kinds of wealth in the native's family. ('Paravatāńśdau' of the text denotes Paravat, or such other higher Vargas: the 2nd lord should be in Paravatāńś, or in Devalokāńś, Brahmalokāńś, Sakravahanāńś, or Sridhamāńś in the Dash Varg scheme)

2.head: Eyes
2.text: If the 2nd lord is endowed with strength, the native will possess beautiful eyes. Should the said graha be in the 6th, Randhra, or the 12th bhava, there will be disease, or deformity of eyes.

2.head: Untruthful Person
2.text: If the 2nd bhava and its Lord are yuti with malefics, the native will be a talebearer, will speak untruth and will be afflicted by windy diseases.

3.head: Indications of the 3rd bhava
3.text: From the 3rd bhava know of the following: valour, servants (attending etc.), brothers, sisters etc., initiatory instructions (Upadesh), journey and parent's death.
O Brahmin, I now tell you about the 3rd bhava. Should the 3rd bhava be yuti with, or drishtied by a benefic, the native will be endowed with co-born and be courageous.
If the 3rd lord along with Mars drishties the 3rd bhava, the native will enjoy good results, due to the 3rd bhava. Alternatively these two grahas may be in the 3rd itself.
Destruction at once of co-born will come to pass, if the said 2 grahas are together with a malefic, or in a rashi, owned by a malefic.

3.head: Female and Male Co-born
3.text: If the 3rd lord is a female graha, or, if the 3rd bhava be occupied by female grahas, one will have sisters, born after him. Similarly male grahas and male rashis denote younger brothers. Should it be of mixed nature, co-born of both sexes will be obtained. These effects be declared after assessing the strength and weakness of the concerned.

Should the 3rd lord and Mars be together in the 8th bhava, destruction of co-born will result. Happiness in this respect will come to pass, if Mars, or the 3rd lord is in an angle, or in a trine, or in exaltation, or friendly divisions.

3.head: Number of Brothers and Sisters
3.text: If Mercury is in the 3rd bhava, while the 3rd lord and the Moon are together, as the indicator (Mars) joins Saturn, the effects are: there occurred the birth of an elder sister and there will be younger brothers. Furthermore, the third brother will die. Should Mars be yuti with Rahu, while the 3rd lord is in his debilitation rashi, there will be loss of younger brothers and/or sisters, while three elder brothers and/or sisters were attained by the native. If the 3rd lord is in an angle, while the significator (Mars) is exalted in a trine and be yuti with Jupiter, 12 will be the number of total co-born. Out of these two elders and the 3rd, the 7th, the 9th and the 12th of the younger co-born will be shortlived, while six of the said twelve will be longlived.

There will be 1 co-born, if the 12th lord (some texts read, as the 11th lord) joins Mars and Jupiter, while the 3rd bhava is occupied by the Moon. If the Moon is lonely placed in the 3rd bhava with drishti of male grahas, there will be younger brothers, while the drishti of Venus denotes younger sisters.

3.head: Adverse grahas
3.text: The Sun in the 3rd bhava will destroy the preborn. The afterborn will be destroyed, if Saturn is found in the 3rd bhava. In the same situation Mars will destroy both the preborn and later-born.
After estimating the strength and weakness of such Yogas, the effects, related to brothers and sisters, be announced.

4.head: Indications of the 4th bhava
4.text: Conveyances, relatives, mother, happiness, treasure, lands and buildings are to be consulted through the 4th bhava.
O excellent of the Brahmins, thus have been briefly told the effects of the 3rd bhava. Now listen to the results, related to the 4th bhava.

4.head: Housing Comforts
4.text: One will have residential comforts in full degree, if Bandhu is occupied by its Lord, or by the 1st lord and be drishtied by a benefic.

4.head: Miscellaneous
4.text: Should the 5th lord be in his own bhava, or in own navamsa, or in exaltation, the native will be endowed with comforts, related to lands, conveyances, houses etc. and musical instruments.

4.head: Housing Comforts
4.text: If the 10th lord joins the 4th lord in an angle, or in a trine, the native will acquire beautiful mansions.

4.head: Relatives
4.text: Should Mercury be in the 1st, while the 4th lord, being a benefic, is drishtied by another benefic, the native will be honoured by his relatives.

4.head: Long-living Mother
4.text: If the 4th bhava is occupied by a benefic, while its Lord is in his exaltation rashi, as the indicator of mother is endowed with strength, the native will have a long-living mother.

4.head: Happiness of Mother
4.text: The native's mother will be happy, if the 4th lord is in an angle, while Venus is also in an angle, as Mercury is exalted.

4.head: Quadrupeds
4.text: The Sun in the 4th, the Moon and Saturn in the 9th and Mars in the 11th bhava; this Yoga will confer cows and buffaloes on the native.

4.head: Dumbness
4.text: Should the 4th bhava be a Movable one, while its Lord and Mars are together in the 6th, or the 8th bhava, the native will be dumb.

4.head: Conveyances
4.text: If the 1st lord is a benefic, while the 4th lord is in fall, or in the 11th bhava and the significator (Venus) is in the 12th bhava, the native will obtain conveyances in his 12th year. Should the Sun be in the 4th bhava, as the 4th lord is exalted and be with Venus, one will acquire conveyances in his 32nd year. It will be in the 42nd year, that one will be endowed with conveyances, if the 4th lord joins the 10th lord in his (4th Lord's) exaltation navamsa. An exchange between Labha's and the 4th lords will confer conveyances in the 12th year. A benefic, related to the 4th bhava (and to its Lord), will bring with him auspicious effects (regarding conveyances), while a malefic will produce only malefic effects (in respect of conveyances). Should a benefic be in the 4th, drishti Bandhu, or in yuti with the Lord of Bandhu, or a drishti on the Lord of the 4th bhava, then the native will be happy with conveyances and be free from accidents and dangers. A malefic, replacing the said benefic, will cause losses, concerning vehicles and reduce one to severe accidents.

5.head: Indications of the 5th bhava
5.text: The learned should deduce from the 5th bhava amulets, sacred spells, learning, knowledge, sons, royalty (or authority), fall of position etc.

O Brahmin, now I tell you the effects, related to the 5th bhava. If the Lords of the Lagna and Putra are in their own rashis, or in an angle, or in a trine, one will enjoy thorough happiness through his children. Should the 5th lord be in the 6th, Randhra, or the 12th bhava, there will be no offspring. Should the Lord of Putra be combust, or be with malefics and be weak, there will be no children; even, if per chance issues are obtained, they will only quit the world soon. The Yuti of the 5th lord with the 1st lord in a good bhava will ensure early obtainment of children apart from happiness through them. If they join in an evil bhava, they will prove a defect in this respect.
If the 5th lord is in the 6th bhava, as the 1st lord is yuti with Mars, the native will lose his very first child, whereafter his female will not be fertile to yield an offspring.
Should the 5th lord be in fall in the 6th, Randhra, or the 12th bhava, while Mercury and Ketu are in the 5th bhava, the native's wife will give birth to one child only.
If the 5th lord is in fall and be not in drishti to Putra, while Saturn and Mercury are in the 5th, the native's wife will give birth to one child only.
Should the 9th lord be in the 1st, while the 5th lord is in fall and Ketu is in the 5th along with Mercury, obtainment of progeny will be after a great deal of ordeal.
If the 5th lord is in the 6th, Randhra, or the 12th bhava, or be in an inimical rashi, or be in fall, or in the 5th itself, the native will beget issues with difficulty.
Should the 5th bhava be owned by Saturn, or Mercury and be occupied, or drishtied by Saturn and Mandi, one will have adopted issues.
Should the Sun and the Moon be together in a rashi and in the same navamsa, the native will be brought up by three mothers, or two fathers.
Adopted issue is indicated, if Putra is tenanted by six grahas, while its Lord is in the 12th bhava and the Moon and the Lagna are endowed with strength.
There will be many children, if the 5th lord is strong, while Putra is drishtied by strong Mercury, Jupiter and Venus.
If the 5th lord is with the Moon, or is in her Decanate, the native will beget daughters; so say Jyotishis.
If the 5th lord is in a Movable rashi, while Saturn is in the 5th, as Rahu is with the Moon, the child (so born) is of questionable birth.
Undoubtedly the native is born of other's loins, if the Moon is in the 8th from the Lagna, while Jupiter is in the 8th from the Moon. Malefic's drishti, or Yuti is essential in this Yog.
If the 5th lord is exalted, or be in the 2nd, Putra, or the 9th bhava, or be yuti with, or drishtied by Jupiter, obtainment of children will be there.

One will obtain children, that will indulge in mean deeds, if Putra is occupied by three, or four malefics, while the 5th lord is in fall. A benefic (including Mercury) in the 5th is excluded in the said combination.
If Putra is occupied by Jupiter, while its Lord is with Venus, one will obtain an offspring in his 32nd, or 33rd year.
Should the 5th lord be in an angle along with Jupiter, the karaka, one will beget a child at the age of 30, or 36.
If Jupiter is in the 9th bhava, while Venus is in the 9th from Jupiter along with the 1st lord, one will beget a child at the age of 40.
The native will at the age of 32 lose his child, if Rahu is in the 5th, the 5th lord is in Yuti with a malefic and Jupiter is in debilitation.
There will be loss of children at 33 and 36, if a malefic is in the 5th from Jupiter, while another is in the 5th from the Lagna.
Should Mandi be in the 1st, while the 1st lord is in fall, grief on account of loss of child at the age of 56 will come to pass.

5.head: Number of Children
5.text: There will be 10 sons, if the 4th bhava and the 6th bhava are occupied by malefics, while the 5th lord is in deep exaltation, joining the 1st lord, as Jupiter is with another benefic. Nine will be the number of sons, that one will beget, if Jupiter is in deep exaltation, as Rahu is with the 2nd lord and Dharma is occupied by its own Lord. There will be eight sons, if Jupiter is in the 5th, or the 9th bhava, while the 5th lord is endowed with strength and the 2nd lord is in the 10th bhava. Saturn in the 9th bhava, while the 5th lord is in the 5th itself, gives 7 sons, out of which twins will be born twice. If the 5th lord is in the 5th in Yuti with the 2nd lord, there will be birth of 7 sons, out of which 3 will pass away. Only one son is denoted, if there be a malefic in the 5th bhava, while Jupiter is in the 5th from Saturn, or vice versa. If the 5th bhava has a malefic in it, or, if Saturn is in the 5th from Jupiter, the native will beget offspring only through his second, or third wife. Should Putra be occupied by a malefic, while Jupiter is yuti with Saturn in the 5th bhava, as the 1st lord is in the 2nd bhava and the 5th lord is yuti with Mars, one will live long, but lose his children one after the other, as they are born.

6.head: Indications of the 6th bhava
6.text: Maternal uncle, doubts about death, enemies, ulcers, step-mother etc. are to be estimated from the 6th bhava.
O Brahmin, following are the effects, produced by the 6th bhava, relating to diseases, ulcers etc. Listen to this attentively.

6.head: Ulcers/Bruises
6.text: Should the 6th lord be in the 6th itself, or in the 1st, or Randhra, there will be ulcers, or bruises on the body. The rashi, becoming the 6th bhava, will lead to the knowledge of the concerned limb.

6.head: Relatives Affected
6.text: The karaka of a relative, or the Lord of such a bhava, joining the 6th lord, or being in the 6th, or the 8th bhava, indicates ulcers/bruises to such a relative, like father. The Sun with such lordship and in such a bhava denotes such affectation of head, the Moon of the face, Mars of the neck, Mercury of the navel, Jupiter of the nose, Venus of the eyes, Saturn of the feet and the Rahu and Ketu of the abdomen.

6.head: Facial Diseases
6.text: Should the 1st lord be in a rashi of Mars, or of Mercury and has a drishti on Mercury, there will be diseases of the face.

6.head: Leprosy
6.text: Mars, or Mercury, having ownership of the ascending rashi and joining the Moon, Rahu and Saturn, will cause leprosy. If the Moon is in the 1st, which is not however Cancer, and be with Rahu, there will occur white leprosy. Saturn in place of Rahu will cause black leprosy, while Mars similarly will afflict one with blood-leprosy.

6.head: Diseases in General
6.text: When the Lagna is occupied by the Lords of Ari and the 8th bhava along with the Sun, the native will be afflicted by fever and tumours. Mars, replacing the Sun, will cause swelling and hardening of the blood vessels and wounds and hits by weapons. Mercury so featuring will bring in billious diseases, while Jupiter in similar case will destroy any disease. Similarly Venus will cause diseases through females, Saturn windy diseases, Rahu danger through low-caste-men and Ketu navel diseases. The Moon in Yuti with the Lords of Ari and the 8th bhava will inflict dangers through water and phlegmatic disorders. Similar estimates be made from the respective significators and bhavas for relatives, like father. 13-19½ TIMING OF ILLNESS. The native will be afflicted by illness throughout life, if Saturn is with Rahu, while the 6th lord and 6th bhava are yuti with malefics. One will suffer from (severe) fever at the age of 6 and at the age of 12, if Mars is in the 6th, while the 6th lord is in the 8th. If the Moon is in Sagittarius/Pisces, while Jupiter is in the 6th from the Lagna, one will suffer from leprosy at the age of 19 and 22. If Rahu is in the 6th, Lagna Lord is in the 8th and Mandi is in an angle, consumption will trouble the native at the age of 26. Spleenary disorders will be experienced at the age of 29 and 30, if the Lords of 6th and 12th are in exchange of their rashis. Saturn and the Moon together in the 6th will inflict blood-leprosy at the age of 45. If Saturn is with an inimical planet, while the 1st lord is in the 1st itself, windy disorders (like rheumatism) will trouble the native at the age of 59.

6.head: UNFORTUNATE YEARS
6.text: Should the Moon be yuti with the 6th lord, while the 8th Lord is in the 6th and the 12th Lord is in the 1st, the native will be troubled by animals at the age of eight. O Brahmin, if Rahu is in the 6th, while Saturn is in the 8th from the said Rahu, the child will have danger through fire at the age of 1 and 2, while in the 3rd year birds will bring some evils.

6.head: UNFORTUNATE YEARS (continued)
6.text: Danger through water will have to be feared during Putra and Dharma years, if the Sun is in the 6th, or Randhra, while the Moon is in the 12th from the said the Sun. Saturn in the 8th, as Mars is in the 7th, all cause small-pox in the 10th year and in 30th year of age. If 8th Lord joins Rahu in an angle/trine from the 8th bhava and be in the 8th in Navamsa, the subject will be troubled by swelling of blood vessels, urinary disorders etc. during the 18th year and the 22nd year.

6.head: LOSS THROUGH ENEMIES
6.text: Loss of wealth will come to pass during the 31st year, if Labha and 6th Lords exchange their rashis.

6.head: INIMICAL SONS
6.text: One's own sons will be his enemies, if the 5th lord is in the 6th, while the 6th lord is with Jupiter. Simultaneously the 12th lord should be in the 1st.

6.head: FEAR FROM DOGS
6.text: There will be fear from dogs during the 10th and 19th year, if the Lagna Lord and the 6th Lord are in exchange.

7.head: Indications of the 7th bhava
7.text: Wife, travel, trade, loss of sight, death etc. be known from the 7th bhava.

O excellent of the Brahmins, listen to me, detailing the effects of the 7th bhava. If the 7th lord is in his own rashi, or in exaltation, one will derive full happiness through his wife (and marriage).

7.head: SICK WIFE
7.text: Should the 7th lord be in the 6th, 8th, or Vyaya, the wife will be sickly. This however does not apply to own bhava, or exaltation placement, as above.

7.head: Excessive'Libidinousness/Death'of'Wife
7.text: If Venus is in the 7th, the native will be exceedingly libidinous. If Venus yuti a malefic in any bhava, it will cause loss of wife.

7.head: THE 7TH LORD
7.text: Should the 7th lord be endowed with strength and be yuti with, or be drishtied by a benefic, the native will be wealthy, honourable, happy and fortunate. Conversely, if the 7th lord is in fall, or is combust, or is in an enemy's rashi, one will acquire sick wives and many wives.

7.head: PLURALITY OF WIVES
7.text: If the 7th lord is in a rashi of Saturn, or of Venus and be drishtied by a benefic, there will be many wives. Should the 7th lord be particularly in exaltation, the same effects will come to pass.

7.head: MlSCELLANEOUS MATTERS
7.text: The native will befriend barren females, if the Sun is in the 7th. The Moon therein will cause association with such female, as corresponding to the rashi, becoming Yuvati. Mars, placed in the 7th, will denote association with marriageable girls (those with menses), or with barren females. Mercury indicates harlots, mean females and females, belonging to traders' community. Wife of a Brahmin, or a pregnant female will be in the native's association, if Jupiter is in the 7th. Base females and females, having attained their courses, are denoted by Saturn, Rahu/Ketu in the 7th.

7.head: Mars denotes a female with attractive breasts
7.text: Saturn indicates sick and weak spouse. Jupiter will bring a spouse with hard and prominent breasts. Venus will bring one with bulky and excellent breasts.

Malefics in the 12th and 7th, while decreasing the Moon is in the 5th denote, that the native will be controlled by spouse, who will be inimical to the race (or family). If the 7th bhava is occupied, or owned by Saturn/Mars, the native will beget a harlot, as his spouse, or he will be attached to other illegally. Should Venus be in a Navamsa of Mars, or in a Rasi of Mars, or receive a drishti from, or be yuti with Mars, the native will 'kiss' the private parts of the female. If Venus is so related to Saturn, the native will 'kiss' the private parts of the male.

7.head: WORTHY SPOUSE
7.text: The native will beget a spouse endowed with (the seven principal) virtues, who will expand his dynasty by sons and grandsons, if the 7th Lord is exalted, while Yuvati is occupied by strong Lagna Lord and a benefic.

7.head: EVILS TO SPOUSE
7.text: If the 7th bhava, or its Lord is yuti with a malefic the native's wife will incur evils, especially, if the 7th bhava, or its Lord is bereft of strength.

7.head: LOSS OF SPOUSE
7.text: If the 7th lord is devoid of strength and is relegated to Ari, 8th, or Vyaya, or, if the 7th lord is in fall, the native's wife will be destroyed (i.e. she will die early).

7.head: LACK OF CONJUGAL FELICITY
7.text: If the Moon is in the 7th, as the 7th lord is in the 12th and the Karaka (indicator Venus) is bereft of strength, the native will not be endowed with marital happiness.

7.head: PLURALlIY OF WIVES
7.text: One will have two wives, if the 7th lord is in fall, or in a malefic rashi along with a malefic, while the 7th bhava, or the 7th Navamsa belong to a eunuch planet. If Mars and Venus are in the 7th, or, if Saturn is Yuvati, while the Lord of the Lagna is in the 8th, the native will have 3 wives. There will be many wives, if Venus is in a Dual rashi, while its Lord is in exaltation, as the 7th lord is endowed with strength.

7.head: TIME OF MARRIAGE (upto Sloka 34)
7.text: If the 7th lord is in a benefic's bhava (or in the 9th, as Subha rashi so means), while Venus is exalted, or is in own rashi, the native will marry at the age of 5, or 9.
If the Sun is in the 7th, while his dispositor is yuti with Venus, there will be marriage at 7th, or 11th year of age.
Venus in the 2nd, while the 7th lord is in the 11th will give marriage at the age of 10, or 16.
Marriage will take place during the 11th year, if Venus is in an angle from the Lagna, while the 1st lord is in Capricorn, or Aquarius.
The native will marry at 12, or l9, if Venus is in an angle from the Lagna, while Saturn is in the 7th counted from Venus.
Should Venus be in the 7th from the Moon, while Saturn is in the 7th from Venus, marriage will be in the 18th year.
Marriage will be in the 15th year, if the 2nd lord is in the 11th, while the 1st lord is in the 10th.
An exchange between the Lords of Dhana and Labha will bring marriage 13 years after birth.
Ones 22nd/27th year will confer marriage, if Venus is in the 7th from the 8th bhava (i.e. Dhana from Lagna), while his dispositor is yuti with Mars.
Should the 7th lord be in the 12th, while the natal Lord is in the 7th in Navamsa, marriage will be in 23rd/26th year of age.
Either the 25th year, or the 33rd year will bring marriage, if the 8th lord is in the 7th, as Venus is in Navamsa Lagna.
Should Venus be in the 9th from Dharma (i.e. in the 5th bhava), while Rahu is in one of the said bhavas (i.e. in the 5th/Dharma), marriage will take place during 31st, or 33rd year.
The native will marry at 30, or 27, if Venus is in the 1st, while the 7th Lord is in the 7th itself.

7.head: TIMING OF WIFE'S DEATH
7.text: Loss of wife will occur in the 18th year, or 33rd year of age of the native, if the 7th lord is in fall, while Venus is in the 8th. One will lose his spouse in his 19th year, if the 7th lord is in the 8th, while the 12th lord is in the 7th. The native's wife will die within three days of marriage due to snake bite, if the native has Rahu in the 2nd and Mars in the 7th. If Venus is in the 8th, while his dispositor is in a rashi of Saturn, death of wife will take place during the native's 12th, or 21st year of age. Should the ascendat Lord be in his rashi of debilitation, as the 2nd lord is in the 8th, loss of wife will occur in the 13th year of age.

7.head: THREE MARRIAGES
7.text: Should the Moon be in the 7th from Venus, while Mercury is in the 7th from the Moon and the 8th lord is in the 5th (from the Lagna), there will be marriage in the 10th year followed by another in the 22nd year and yet another in the 33rd year.
DEATH OF WlFE. lf Ari, 7th and 8th are in their order occupied by Mars, Rahu and Saturn, the native's wife will not live (long).

8.head: Indications of the 8th bhava
8.text: The 8th bhava indicates longevity, battle, enemies, forts, wealth of the dead and things, that have happened and are to happen (in the past and future births).

8.head: Long Life
8.text: O excellent of the Brahmins, listen to me speak on the effects of the 8th bhava. If the 8th lord is in an angle, long life is indicated.

8.head: Short Life
8.text: Should the 8th lord join the 1st lord, or a malefic and be in the 8th itself, the native will be short lived.

8.head: Saturn and the 10th lord about Longevity
8.text: Similarly consider Saturn and the 10th lord in the matter of longevity. The 10th lord is in the 8th along with a malefic graha and/or the 1st lord.

8.head: Long Life
8.text: There will be long life, if the 6th lord is in the 12th, or, if the 6th lord is in the 6th, as the 12th lord is in the 12th, or, if the 6th lord and the 12th lord are in the 1st and Randhra. If the Lords of Putra, Randhra and the 1st bhava are in own navamsa, own rashis, or in friendly rashis, the native will enjoy a long span of life. Should the Lords of the Lagna, Randhra and the 10th bhava and Saturn are all disposed severally in an angle, in a trine, or in the 11th bhava, the subject will live long. Like these, there are many other Yogas, dealing with the issue of longevity. The strength and weakness of the grahas concerned be estimated in deciding longevity.

8.head: Short Life
8.text: One's span of life will be between 20 and 32 years, if the 1st lord is weak, while the 8th lord is an angle. The native will only be short-lived, if the 8th lord is in fall, while the 8th bhava has a malefic in it and the 1st bhava is bereft of strength. Death will be instant at birth, if the 8th bhava, the 8th lord and the 12th bhava are all conjunct malefics. Malefics in angles and/or trines and benefics in the 6th and/or the 8th bhava, while the 1st bhava has in it the 8th lord in fall: this Yoga will cause immediate end. If Putra and the 8th bhava and the 8th lord are all conjunct malefics, the life span will be very brief. Within a month of birth, death will befall the child, if the 8th lord is in the 8th itself, while the Moon is with malefics and be bereft of beneficial drishti.

8.head: Long Life (again)
8.text: One will be long-lived, if the 1st lord is in exaltation, while the Moon and Jupiter are, respectively, in the 11th and the 8th bhava. If the 1st lord is exceedingly strong and receives a drishti from a benefic, which is placed in an angle, the person concerned will be wealthy, virtuous and long-lived.

9.head: Indications of the 9th bhava
9.text: Fortunes, wife's brother, religion, brother's wife, visits to shrines etc. be known from the 9th bhava.

9.head: Fortunate (Affluent) Father
9.text: If the 9th lord is with strength, as Venus is in the 9th, while Jupiter is in an angle from the 1st bhava, the native's father is fortunate.

9.head: Indigent Father
9.text: If the 9th lord is debilitated, while the 2nd and/or the 4th from the 9th bhava is occupied by Mars, the native's father is poor.

9.head: Long-living Father
9.text: Should the 9th lord be in deep exaltation, while Venus is in an angle from the 1st bhava and Jupiter is in the 9th from navamsa the Lagna, the father of the native will enjoy a long span of life.

9.head: Royal Status for Father
9.text: If the 9th lord is an angle and receives a drishti from Jupiter, the native's father will be a king endowed with conveyances, or be equal to a king.

9.head: Wealthy and Famous Father
9.text: Should the 9th lord be in the 10th bhava, while the 10th lord receives a drishti from a benefic the native's father will be very rich and famous.

9.head: Virtuous and Devoted to Father
9.text: Should the Sun be in deep exaltation, as the 9th lord is in the 11th bhava, the native will be virtuous, dear to the king and devoted to father. If the Sun is in a trine from Lagna, while the 9th lord is in the 7th in yuti with, or receiving a drishti from Jupiter, the native will be devoted to his father.

9.head: Fortunes etc
9.text: Acquisition of fortunes, conveyances and fame will follow the 32nd year of age, if the 9th lord is in the 2nd, while the 2nd lord is in the 9th.

9.head: Inimical to Father
9.text: There will be mutual enmity between the father and the native, if the 1st lord is in the 9th bhava, but with the Lord of Ari. Further, the native's father will be of contemptible disposition.

9.head: Begged Food
9.text: If the 10th lord and the 3rd lord are bereft of strength, while the 9th lord is in fall, or combust the native will go begging for his food.

9.head: Combinations for Father's Death
9.text: The father of the native would have passed away prior to the native's birth, if the Sun is in the 6th, Randhra, or the 12th bhava, as the 8th lord is in the 9th bhava, the 12th lord is in the 1st bhava and the 6th lord is in the 5th bhava. Should the Sun be in the 8th bhava, while the 8th lord is in the 9th, the native's father will pass away within a year of his birth. If the Lord of the 12th bhava is in the 9th bhava, while the 9th lord is in its debilitation navamsa, the native's father will face his end during the 3rd, or the 16th year of the native. Death of father will occur in the 2nd, or the 12th year, if the 1st lord is in the 8th bhava, as the 8th lord is with the Sun. Should Rahu be in the 8th from Dharma, as the Sun is in the 9th from Dharma, death of father will take place in the 16th, or the 18th year of the native. If Saturn is in the 9th from the Moon, as the Sun is with Rahu, the native's father will die in the 7th, or the 19th year of the native. The native in his 44th year will lose his father, if the 9th lord is in the 12th, as the 12th lord is in the 9th. If the 1st lord is in the 8th bhava, as the Moon is in the Sun's navamsa, the native in his 35th, or 41st year will lose his father. One will lose his father in the 50th year, if the Sun, being the Lord of Dharma, is conjunct Mars and Saturn. If the Sun is in the 7th from the 9th bhava, as Rahu is in the 7th from the 3rd bhava, the 6th, or 25th year of the native will be fatal for father. If Saturn is in the 7th from the 8th bhava, as the Sun is in the 7th from Saturn, the ages of 21, 26, or 30 will be fatal for the father. If the 9th lord is in its debilitation rashi, while his dispositor is in the 9th bhava, the native will lose his father at the age of 26, or 30. Thus the Jyotishis may know the effects.

9.head: Fortunes
9.text: One will enjoy abundant fortunes, if Venus is in deep exaltation and be in the company of the 9th lord, as Saturn is in the 3rd.

9.head: Fortunate Periods
9.text: Abundant fortunes be acquired after the 20th year, if Dharma has Jupiter in it, as its Lord is in an angle from the Lagna. Should Mercury be in his deep exaltation, as the 9th lord is in the 9th itself, abundant fortunes will be earned after the 36th year.
Should the 1st lord be in the 9th, as the 9th lord is in the 1st and Jupiter is in the 7th, there will be gains of wealth and conveyances.

9.head: Lack of Fortunes
9.text: If Rahu is in the 9th from the 9th bhava, as his dispositor is in the 8th bhava and the 9th lord is in fall, the native be devoid of fortunes.

9.head: Food by Begging
9.text: Should Saturn be in the 9th bhava along with the Moon, as the 1st lord is in fall, the native will acquire food by begging.

O Brahmin, these are the effects related to the 9th bhava. I have explained briefly. These may be estimated with the help of the state of the Lords of the Lagna and the 9th bhava and in other manners as well.

10.head: Indications of the 10th bhava
10.text: Royalty (authority), place, profession (livelihood), honour, father, living in foreign lands and debts are to be understood from the 10th bhava.
I now explain the effects of the 10th bhava. Listen to these, o Maitreya, in the words of Brahma, Garga and others.

10.head: Paternal Happiness
10.text: If the 10th lord is strong and in exaltation, or in its own rashi/navamsa, the native will derive extreme paternal happiness, will enjoy fame and will perform good deeds.
If the 10th lord is devoid of strength, the native will face obstructions in his work. If Rahu is in an angle, or in a trine, he will perform religious sacrifices, like Jyotishtoma.
If the 10th lord is with a benefic, or be in an auspicious bhava, one will always gain through royal patronage and in business. In a contrary situation, only opposite results will come to pass.
Should Karma and the 11th bhava be both occupied by malefics, the native will indulge only in bad deeds and will defile his own men.
If the Lord of the 10th bhava is relegated to the 8th bhava along with Rahu, the native will hate others; be a great fool and will do bad deeds.

If Saturn, Mars and the 10th lord are in the 7th, as the 7th lord is with a malefic, the native will be fond of carnal pleasures and of filling his belly. 8-10 Should the 10th lord be in exaltation and be in the company of Jupiter, as the 9th lord is in the 10th the native will be endowed with honour, wealth and valour. One will lead a happy life, if the 11th lord is in the 10th and the 10th lord is in the 1st, or, if the Lord of the 10th bhava is yuti with the Lord of the 11th bhava in an angle. Should the 10th lord in strength be in Pisces along Jupiter, the native will doubtless obtain robes, ornaments and happiness.
Should Rahu, the Sun, Saturn and Mars be in the 11th bhava, the native will incur cessation of his duties.
One will be learned and wealthy, if Jupiter is in Pisces along with Venus, while the 1st lord is strong and the Moon is in exaltation.
Should the 10th lord be in the 11th, while the 11th lord is in the 1st bhava and Venus is in the 10th, the native will be endowed with precious stones.
If the 10th lord is exalted in an angle, or a trine and is yuti with Jupiter, or receives a drishti from Jupiter, one will be endowed with deeds.
Should the 10th lord be in the 1st along with the 1st lord, as the Moon is in an angle, or in a trine, the native will be interested in good deeds.
If Saturn is in the 10th bhava along with a debilitated graha, while the 10th bhava in the navamsa Kundali is occupied by a malefic, the native will be bereft of acts.
One will indulge in bad acts, if the 10th lord is in the 8th bhava, while the 8th lord is in the 10th bhava with a malefic.
Obstructions to the native's acts will crop up, if the 10th lord is in fall, as both the 10th bhava and the 10th from the 10th bhava have malefic occupations.

10.head: Combinations for Fame
10.text: One will be endowed with fame, if the Moon is in the 10th bhava, while the 10th lord is in a trine from the 10th bhava and the 1st lord is in the Lagna's angle. Similar effects will come to pass, if the 11th lord is in the 10th bhava, while the 10th lord is strong and gives a drishti to Jupiter. Fame will come to the native, if the 10th lord is in the 9th bhava, as the 1st lord is in the 10th bhava and the Moon is in the 5th bhava.

O excellent of the Brahmins, thus have been told about the effects of the 10th bhava in a brief manner. Other related effects be guessed by you based on the relationship of the Lords of the Lagna and of the 10th bhava.

11.head: Indications of the 11th bhava
11.text: All articles, son's wife, income, prosperity, quadrupeds etc. are to be understood from the 11th bhava.
O excellent of the Brahmins, I now explain effects relating to the 11th bhava, the auspiciousness of which bhava will make one happy at all times.

Should the 11th lord be in the 11th itself, or be in an angle, or in a trine from the Lagna, there will be many gains. Similarly, if the 11th lord is exalted, though in combustion there will be many gains.
If the 11th lord is in the 2nd bhava, while the 2nd lord is in an angle along with Jupiter, the gains will be great.
If the 11th lord is in the 3rd bhava, while the 11th bhava is occupied by a benefic, the native will gain 2000 Nishkas in his 36th year.
If the 11th lord is yuti with a benefic in an angle, or in a trine, the native will acquire 500 Nishkas in his 40th year.
The native will own 6000 Nishkas, if the 11th bhava is occupied by Jupiter, while the 2nd bhava and the 9th bhava are, respectively, taken over by the Moon and Venus by position.
Should Jupiter, Mercury and the Moon be in the 11th from Labha, the native will be endowed with wealth, grains, fortunes, diamonds, ornaments etc.
One will gain 1000 Nishkas in his 33rd year, if the 11th lord is in the 1st and the 1st lord is in the 11th bhava.
If the 11th lord is in the 2nd bhava, as the 2nd lord is in the 11th bhava, one will amass abundant fortunes after marriage.
If the 11th lord is in the 3rd bhava, as the 3rd lord is in the 11th bhava, one will gain wealth through co-borns and will be endowed with excellent ornaments.
There will be no gains in spite of numerous efforts, if the 11th lord is in fall, in combustion, or be in the 6th, Randhra, or the 12th bhava with a malefic.

12.head: Indications of the 12th bhava
12.text: From the 12th bhava, one can know about expenses, history of enemies, one's own death etc.

O Brahmin, now I tell you about the effects of the 12th bhava. There will be expenses on good accounts, if the 12th lord is with a benefic, or in his own bhava, or exalted, or, if a benefic occupies Vyaya. One will own beautiful houses and beds and be endowed with superior scented articles and pleasures, if the Moon happens to be the 12th lord and be exalted, or be in its own rashi and/or navamsa, or in the 11th/Dharma/the 5th bhava in rashi/navamsa. The said native will live with rich clothes and ornaments, be learned and Lordly.

And, if the 12th lord is in the 6th, or the 8th bhava, or be in enemy's navamsa, in debilitation navamsa, or in the 8th bhava in navamsa, one will be devoid of happiness from wife, be troubled by expenses and deprived of general happiness. If he be in an angle, or trine, the native will beget a spouse.
Just as these effects are derived from the 1st bhava in regard to the native, similar deductions be made about co-borns etc. from Sahaja and other bhavas.
Grahas placed in the visible half of the zodiac will give explicit results, while the ones in the invisible half will confer secret results.
If Rahu is in the 12th along with Mars, Saturn and the Sun, the native will go to hell. Similar effect will occur, if the 12th lord is with the Sun.
If there is a benefic in the 12th, while its Lord is exalted, or is yuti with, or receives a drishti from a benefic, one will attain final emancipation.
One will wander from country to country, if the 12th lord and the 12th bhava are with malefics and the 12th lord gives a drishti to, or receives a drishti from malefics.
One will move in his own country, if the 12th lord and the 12th bhava are with benefics and the 12th lord gives a drishti to, or receives a drishti from benefics.
Earnings will be through sinful measures, if Vyaya is occupied by Saturn, or Mars etc. and is not receiving a drishti from a benefic.
If the 1st lord is in the 12th, while the 12th lord is in the 1st with Venus, expenses will be on religious grounds.

bhavas_judge.head: Prosperity, or Annihilation of a bhava
bhavas_judge.text: Predict prosperity of the bhava, which is yuti with, or drishtied by a benefic. Also, when its Lord is in Yuvavastha, or Prabuddhavastha, or in Kismaravastha, or in the 10th bhava, the bhavas well-being is indicated. The bhava, which is not drishtied by its Lord, or, whose Lord is with a malefic graha, or with one of the Lords of evil and such other bhavas (i.e. 3rd, 6th, 8th, 11th and 12th), or is defeated in a war between grahas, or is in one of the three Avasthas, viz, Vriddhavastha, Mritavastha and Suptavastha.

bhavas_karakas.head: Bhava Significance
bhavas_karakas.text: I now narrate the significance of the bhavas. The 1st bhava denotes the soul (self), Dhana family, finance, wife etc., Sahaja younger brothers/sisters, Putra progeny and Yuvati wife. It is also said, that a graha in the 5th becomes a karaka for wife. The Karakatwas of the bhava in order are the Sun, Jupiter, Mars, the Moon, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn.

O excellent of the Brahmins, after knowing the merits of the 1st bhava etc. The good and bad effects can be declared. Ari, Randhra and Vyaya are Trikas, Dusthan, or malefic bhavas. Sahaja, Ari, Karma and Labha are Upachayas. Dhana, Putra, Randhra and Labha are Panapharas and Sahaja, Ari, Dharma and Vyaya are Apoklimas. Association with Trikas will inflict evils. kendras and Konas (Putra and Dharma) are auspicious bhavas, the association with which turns even evil into auspiciousness. (Also see Ch. 34 for more information)
